dataset.name: PKLot
dataset.citation: P. R. L. de Almeida, L. S. Oliveira, A. S. Britto Jr., E. J. Silva Jr., A. L. Koerich. PKLot: A robust dataset for parking lot classification. Expert Systems with Applications 42(11), 2015. doi:10.1016/j.eswa.2015.02.009
dataset.note: Cameras PUCPR, UFPR04 and UFPR05 in Curitiba, Brazil. Sample frames recompressed (JPEG quality 82); polygons and occupied flags as in the dataset.

rule.text: a space is taken when one car, bus or truck box with confidence above 0.05 covers at least 40% of the space's area; the detector runs on the whole frame and on 3 x 3 overlapping tiles

eval.dataset: PKLot (Almeida et al., Expert Systems with Applications, 2015)
eval.source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Voxel51/PKLot (FiftyOne copy of the official PKLot release, web.inf.ufpr.br/vri/databases/parking-lot-database/)
eval.detector: YOLO26n (model_n.onnx), classes car, bus, truck, input 960 x 544, whole frame plus 3 x 3 overlapping tiles

rule.text: a space is taken when one car, bus or truck box with confidence above 0.05 covers at least 40% of the space's area; the detector runs on the whole frame and on 3 x 3 overlapping tiles
a space is taken when one vehicle box with confidence above 0.1 covers at least 20% of the space's area
a space is taken when one car, bus or truck box with confidence above 0.05 covers at least 40% of the space's area; the detector runs on the whole frame and on 2 x 2 overlapping tiles
a space is taken when one vehicle box with confidence above 0.05 covers at least 40% of the space's area

eval.note: The page and these numbers use the browser model (model_n.onnx). reference_runs: the same test images with the yolo26n.pt weights, without tiles and with tiles (before the tile box-size filter).

suggest.rule: every car box with confidence 0.1 or more is a taken space; cars are chained into rows; a gap in a row that fits k cars at the row pitch is k free spaces, unless a vehicle box covers 40% of it
